CIA Season 2 premieres Monday, Oct 5th on CBS and streaming on Paramount+!

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CIACBS
Follow CIA on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/fbicbs
Follow CIA on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@fbiscbs
Like CIA on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/FBICBS
Watch more CIA HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/cia

CIA focuses on a clandestine CIA/FBI task force where secretive and roguish CIA Agent Colin Glass finds himself teamed up with by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman. The duo work together on covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells and geopolitical secrets. Also on the team is Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard and CIA Analyst Gina Gosian.

On CIA, Bill continues to learn the rules of this murky world on the fly as Colin leads him deeper into spy games where only one thing is clear – their work keeps America safe, even if no one will ever know what they did in the shadows.

recentItems.title: Cupertino: Official Trailer | CBS
recentItems.description:
Big tech can’t bring them down. From the creators of THE GOOD WIFE, EVIL, and ELSBETH, new series CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. Series premiere Thursday, October 8 on CBS and Paramount+.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CupertinoCBS
Follow Cupertino on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cupertinocbs
Like Cupertino on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/cupertinocbs

CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. A lawyer (Mike Colter) is cheated out of his stock options by his former employer, a tech start-up. Refusing to back down, he joins forces with another recently fired attorney (Rachel Keller) to represent those taken advantage of by the tech elite and help them fight back in a high-stakes battle against the Goliaths controlling Silicon Valley.
